'''C-069'''<ref name="tcwce">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] seen in the [[Senate]] along with senator [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]]. He was later serving [[Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac/Legends|drinks]] to Deechi and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Burtoni]] when [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] came to talk to them about [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr's]] [[Death/Legends|death]].
